capture.command: named on docker network fxlab-e (10.250.70.53) with allow-transfer { 10.250.70.0/24; }, TCP 53 published on 127.0.0.1:15353; a throwaway capture program inside apps/collectors ran the collector's own dnszone.Transfer(ctx, <recording proxy>, zone, nil) through a TCP proxy that relayed to 127.0.0.1:15353 and wrote both directions byte for byte, once per zone (lab.openmap.test, 70.250.10.in-addr.arpa). No TSIG (TSIG MACs bind to the request MAC and cannot be replayed).
